scripts.version:sync: bash -c 'if V=$(git describe --tags --exact-match HEAD 2>/dev/null | sed s/^v//) && [ -n "$V" ]; then npm pkg set version="$V"; else TAG=$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 2>/dev/null | sed s/^v//); TAG=${TAG:-0.0.0}; N=$(git rev-list ${TAG:+$TAG..}HEAD --count 2>/dev/null || git rev-list HEAD --count); C=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD); D=$(date +%Y%m%d); npm pkg set version="${TAG}.dev${N}+g${C}.d${D}"; fi'
scripts.build: npm run version:sync && tsc && vite build
scripts.test:e2e:check: curl -sf http://localhost:8000/health > /dev/null || (echo 'ERROR: FastAPI backend not running. Start servers with VS Code task: Start All (Devcontainer)' && exit 1); test $(curl -sf -H 'X-API-Key: demo-api-key-12345' 'http://localhost:8000/v1/zones' | grep -c '"zone":') -gt 0 || (echo 'ERROR: No zones loaded. Is BIND running?' && exit 1)
